scope: M2R Editorial Readiness Layer: reader-interest strategy selection and forbidden patterns. AUGMENTS the frozen CHRONOMORIE_SITE_DNA + VOICE_HOUSE + MODE profiles; it does not replace or mutate them (M2R §22). Derived from the frozen profiles' own headline/opening statistics, not new house rules.

observed_headline_reader_interest: Digits in ~26-32% of recent headlines (number-led service/incident forms are established house practice).
Result/decision forms ('взе три точки', 'прие...') are the dominant newsworthiness surface.
Headlines are direct informative (40-60 chars, 7-9 words); no colon/question/exclamation (0% in 2020-2026 bands).
Opening classes: immediate_fact ~77% in recent house; scene/quote openings only where MODE_CULTURE_FEATURE allows them.
corpus_basis.conclusion: The house already leads with strongest-fact and consequence forms; the profiles encode HOW. This artifact encodes WHEN each reader-interest strategy applies and WHAT is forbidden. No M2.2 profile was changed.

STRONGEST_FACT.use_when: A concrete decision, result or announcement with clear verification context (who/what/when/status).
STRONGEST_FACT.profile_alignment: MODE_STANDARD_NEWS 'immediate_fact' opening (~77%); direct fact headline form.

CONSEQUENCE.use_when: Evidence shows what the event changes or enables (ще даде / ще позволи / ще осигури).
CONSEQUENCE.profile_alignment: STANDARD_NEWS P1 fact + P2-P3 detail/context pacing.

SCALE.use_when: A credible number carries the interest (edition count, participants, amount).
SCALE.profile_alignment: Number-led headline form ('21 сигнала за мазут...'); digits in headlines are house practice.

LOCAL_IMPACT.use_when: Named local group/place is affected; default for serious local subjects.
LOCAL_IMPACT.profile_alignment: SITE DNA local_specificity (Burgas-region anchors, formal institution naming).

HUMAN_INTEREST.use_when: Affected people or participants are concrete in evidence (not invented sympathy).

CURIOSITY.use_when: Evidence contains an unusual or surprising concrete element; grounded curiosity only.
CURIOSITY.profile_alignment: No profile precedent needed; subject to the same no-clickbait rules.

UNUSUAL_DETAIL.use_when: A specific distinctive element (за пръв път, рекорд, новина-елемент) is supported.

PRACTICAL_VALUE.use_when: Admission, schedule, format or participation info is the reader's direct benefit.
PRACTICAL_VALUE.profile_alignment: EVENT_PREVIEW practical closing line; announcement -> program -> practical pacing.

PLAYFUL.use_when: Entertainment/culture subject AND a supported comic/unusual premise in evidence (M2R §18).
PLAYFUL.profile_alignment: EVENT_PREVIEW guidance: light editorial hook for CULTURE/COMEDY/ENTERTAINMENT only; omitted when evidence is calendar-only.

serious_subject_rule: For death, crime, serious accident, health emergency, court proceedings, minors, human tragedy or serious allegations, only STRONGEST_FACT, CONSEQUENCE or LOCAL_IMPACT may be selected (M2R §17). Playful, sensational or emotionally manipulative framing is never generated.

headline_behavior.candidates: Up to 3 headline variants with different truthful emphasis: direct factual; reader-interest/strongest angle; more energetic within house tone. Variants are editor options - never labelled in output.
headline_behavior.house_constraints: No colon, question or exclamation marks in headlines (0% in 2020-2026 bands); 40-60 chars, 7-9 words typical; occasional quoted title only as allowed by MODE_CULTURE_FEATURE.

forbidden_clickbait_rule: No headline may open a curiosity gap it does not close, promise an emotion instead of a fact, or use the forbidden patterns above in any form (M2R §20). A rhetorical question is not a loophole for unsupported factual premises.
learning_note: Newsworthiness thresholds and hook rules remain provisional (M2R §23, §34): no automatic profile mutation from single editor reviews; aggregate editor outcomes first. Editor outcomes recorded on cases: ANGLE_ACCEPTED | ANGLE_CHANGED | NO_STORY_CONFIRMED | RESEARCH_REQUESTED (readiness_outcome field).
